objective: verify fixed-operating-point pressure/thrust/Isp/mass-flow consistency; do not infer unpublished Raptor parameters

missing: measured mass flow and throttle/transient map

bench_cases.changes_allowed: none after execution; data are synthetic dimensional fixtures, not Raptor inputs

acceptance: anchor force and Isp reproduced at reference pressure
ambient-pressure variation leaves mass flow unchanged at fixed operating point
force difference equals fixed nozzle area times pressure difference
separately supplied full/partial points retain same fixed-nozzle pressure correction
reject unsupported pressure, invalid finite/domain inputs and nonpositive/overflow outputs
CLI refuses existing output without overwriting

budgets.unit_and_failure_path_checks: focused algebraic/CLI checks allowed; not flight experiments
budgets.bench_invocation_definition: one fresh positive runtime verification report for corrected software; focused unit and refusal-path checks are additionally allowed and logged. No flight or tuning trial.

outcome_rules.then: preserve failure; stop stage2a; do not activate curve or rerun as success

outcome_rules.when: bench passes and primary Raptor parameter gaps persist
outcome_rules.then: close2a with known activation gap after software review; any2b ascent fit is conditional on frozen constant-thrust/common-Ship-Isp assumptions and is not evidence identifying true guidance or propulsion

outcome_rules.when: new source or alternative physical assumptions proposed
outcome_rules.then: separate source-bound registration/approval before activation; never fit unknown area/Isp to desired ascent

flight_activation.reason: Raptor inputs and consistent controller/sensor/fault capability mappings not established; steady bench is not a flight map

revision_reason: C5 review fixes: enforce complete4point/2pair matrix and add CLI regression tests; preserve primary errors when report output fails. No operating point/pressure/threshold/flight parameter changed.
fixture_interpretation: Independent synthetic dimensional points only; not a physically validated throttle map. Pressure bands do not establish full-flow/no-separation limits of any real nozzle.
